workflow.agent_system: shared AGENTS workflow for Codex, Claude and other agents
workflow.logging_policy: Snapshot only, <=8000 bytes. Report directly; delete generated test/build outputs after inspection. Preserve regression sources and user data.

current_capabilities.geometry_and_vector: Analytical curves/arcs, adaptive flattening, intersections, dynamic offset/contour, OSnap inference engine, Pen tracing with Shift-only angle snapping and auto-commit to Node tool, direct segment bending (BendSegment) & multi-node curve conversion, Live Corners with 2x2 property bar, interactive dragging for Round/Scallop/Chamfer with single-step undo batching, Contour floor 0.02 mm; NumericFieldDescriptor maps semantic keys. General filled-path Boolean uses pinned Clipper2 2.0.1 with bounded flattening, checked integer quantization, fill-rule/hole preservation. Layout and Properties page-unit controls route semantic ActionIds; page units drive parser, coordinates, HUD, rulers, fields, tooltips, Snap Grid, presets and import/recovery size labels.
current_capabilities.document_and_color: Design files .pr only; schema v23/v24, containers v23-v25, reader v2-v25. No fixed file/object/element cap; u32 widths and half-free-RAM read quota remain. Persists ICC/colors, raster graph, fidelity, text/layers/artboards. Persistent AVL map and hierarchy update compatible touched edits; structural changes rebuild. Atomic save streams 1 MiB chunks and patches CRC; load remains full-buffer. Partial raster source/sample dedup; crop-first and in-place pointwise evaluator; async edited RGB+A histogram. Index, lazy assets and bounded streaming load remain.
current_capabilities.rendering: Windows ViewportRenderer uses Direct2D 1.1/D3D11 hardware or WARP; default NativeWindow reads full BGRA frames for GDI. Opt-in PIKDRAW_DIRECT_PRESENT=1 uses HWND swap-chain canvas without readback and composites GDI chrome, canvas overlays/handles and topmost UI after D2D. Canonical Release app relinked; full desktop-shell CTest passes 1/1 after fixing Artboard status indexing. Modal overlay order still awaits fresh visual capture. Reused targets, 1024-entry/256 MiB image-upload LRU, AABB BVH, ICC preview and GDI dirty-copy cache; SoftwareRasterizer is CPU fallback/oracle.
current_capabilities.desktop_shell: Win32 Native Shell shares DIP paint/hit geometry and updates on DPI changes. Gradient Studio: interactive ramp slider, stop pins, midpoint diamonds, presets, reverse/distribute, screen-space canvas handles & live bidirectional sync. Typography: granular delta mutations, Shift+F3 case cycling, linked frames, Combine/Split, Text on Path. PowerClip geometric editing with nested scopes and views.
current_capabilities.automation_ecosystem: Shared typed AutomationService; MCP Streamable HTTP hosted in desktop process. NativeWindow E2E verifies AC01 600x300 mm Vietnamese layout/font/margins/colors/icons, stable IDs, edit/undo after reopen, 5x2m design, Settings revoke/stale-endpoint. AC02 RPC verifies atomic undo/redo IDs; AC07 RPC verifies 1,000-object paging. AC03 stale-write and active text-draft rejection preserve local edits; AC09 dirty-tab preservation passes. COM registered STA/MTA smoke passes. Stdio MCP sidecar and Windows COM IDispatch local server.
current_capabilities.external_vector_import: CDR/PDF/AI/EPS import and DXF topology; PNG/BigTIFF and CMYK16 TIFF sample oracles. Raster graph v17: U8/U16 tone/color, masks, RGB ICC Assign/Convert, Light/Color Balance/HSL/Vibrance Properties; source provider is session-only. Production: test sheets, TAC, CGATS/CSV ΔE00, .pdmr, WCS job hash. Integrated test, page U16, tiles/proof/plates, driver and physical print remain open.

known_limitations: Qt 6 and Skia backends are future architectural targets pending unified MinGW/MSVC toolchain ABI; runtime currently standardizes on Win32 Native Shell + Direct2D 1.1 / D3D11 + WARP.

Interactive drag reuses cached canvas and dirty GDI copy, but changed snapshots still render/read back full-frame by default. No GPU partial-render/tile cache. Opt-in HWND swap-chain re-composites GDI canvas handles and topmost UI after D2D; modal fix is compiled/linked but not visually re-captured. DPI migration, visible FPS and input-to-present remain unverified.
DPI coverage uses synthetic 120/144/192/96 DPI events and native captures; physical monitor switching, reference-device latency and production fidelity remain unverified.

Auto-recovery writes use bounded jobs over immutable snapshots. Startup scan, selected recovery and UI .pr open run off UI thread; cancellation covers chunked reads, CRC/parse and v24 inflate/CRC windows <=64 KiB. Open/recovery reads and DocumentSnapshot construction remain full-buffer; cancel latency is unknown. Atomic save streams payload and remains uncancelled for durability. Import/export run below normal priority with coalesced progress. Pointer moves keep the latest sample on one 16 ms UI timer and flush before other messages; coalescer and save/recovery tests pass. W0, visible/input latency, shutdown lifecycle and Job Object filesystem/network containment remain unverified.

CDR uses pinned libcdr-to-SVG subset; PDF/AI use PDFium mapping and EPS uses eps-path-v1 or isolated Ghostscript conversion. PDF page rotations 0/90/180/270 are mapped; object-level rotated/sheared text, effects/clipping, multiple OCG membership, Corel live effects, ICC fidelity, visual/coordinate oracle, all CDR versions, source round-trip, UI runtime, and production remain unverified. Import pauses at 95% RAM and resumes after headroom returns; structural/wire/time limits remain.

TAC is diagnostic only; not auto-limited. Raster TAC uses RGB-to-CMYK ICC estimates; spot/raster plates, output-condition linkage, overprint and proof/gamut oracle remain open. Test TIFF is sRGB; direct WCS print records destination-profile hash, but driver association and physical print are unverified. CGATS/CSV has .pdmr storage and basic import UI; hard proof remains open.

General path Boolean is a bounded polygon approximation: curve flattening and grid quantization produce an explicit error bound, but near-contact topology and manufacturing acceptance are not proven. General Boundary/Simplify and cooperative cancellation remain unsupported.

Native atomic save streams payload chunks; load remains buffered. Production: test sheets, TAC, ΔE00, .pdmr/report, WCS print with destination-profile hash. Integrated Release suite pending. P1/P2/P3/P5/P6/P7 partial: persistent tiles, page U16, monitor/proof, advanced retouch/filters/presets, plates/PDF-X, hard proof. Driver association/physical print/P8 branches remain open.
